caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate outdoor scene viewed from under a covered terrace with large marble columns adorned with gold capitals, draped with dark pink curtains and gold tassels. The floor is a black-and-white checkerboard pattern. At the right foreground, a peacock stands next to a vase of pink and purple flowers. There are several large floral arrangements in ornate vases or urns scattered throughout the terrace and on pedestals. The terrace opens onto a grand staircase leading downward to a balustrade and a garden filled with more flowers. In the center background, there is a fountain surrounded by blooming plants, with water spraying upward, and tall trees in the background. A circular domed building with columns is visible beyond the fountain, and a statue stands atop a pillar to the left. The sky is painted in soft pastels, primarily pink and blue. There is a decorative banner above the balustrade, inscribed with the names Mansfield, Sothern, and B.F. Whitney. The entire composition uses pastel hues interspersed with gold detailing, with a focus on architectural and natural decorative elements.
title: Stage Set
